convention: After moving by its velocity, a coordinate below 0 has 1000 added and a coordinate above 1000 has 1000 subtracted, once per update. Exactly 0 and exactly 1000 are both left as they are.

cases.name: inside the area: only the velocity is applied
right edge: leaves at 1000 and comes back on the left
left edge: leaves at 0 and comes back on the right
bottom edge: leaves at 1000 and comes back at the top
top edge: leaves at 0 and comes back at the bottom
corner: both coordinates wrap in the same update
one coordinate wraps, the other does not
landing exactly on 1000 does not wrap
landing exactly on 0 does not wrap
a negative coordinate is brought back into the area
a coordinate just above 1000 is brought back into the area
a negative coordinate too small to change 1000 lands exactly on 1000
more than one width outside: only one wrap is applied per update
